'''Shiny Orbs''' are {{Common}} items related to the [[Year of the Pig]] event. They can be used on a {{MobSprite|Shiny Pig}} to obtain rewards.

== Obtaining ==
During the [[Year of the Pig]] event, '''Shiny Orbs''' can be purchased from the [[Pig Shop]] for {{c|5k}}.

== Usage ==
Right-clicking a [[Shiny Pig]] with a '''Shiny Orb''' will launch the pig a short distance away while the orb hovers in place where it was clicked. Bringing the pig back to the orb within 90 seconds will grant a reward.

== Trivia ==
*When the [[Blood God Shrine]] was active, '''Shiny Orbs''' had a very small chance to give the player a {{Item|Shiny Relic}}.
**This feature was removed when the {{NPCSprite|Ancient Pig}} was summoned.
*'''Shiny Orbs''' were added as part of {{RN|Pig|[https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCFAiFyGs6oDiF1Nf-rRJpZA {{pink|Technoblade}}]}}'s mayor perks, due to his position as the [[Resistance Leader]].
* Although the ''''Shiny Orb's''' description says to right-click a {{MobSprite|Shiny Pig}}, left-clicking them also works.
*The message received in the chat after clicking a charged orb has a misspelling. The word "piglet's" is spelled with two g's in the message.<!--Didn't this get fixed at some point?-->
*'''Shiny Orbs''' could previously be placed on [[Private Island|Private Islands]]. This got patched, but some islands still have remaining orbs.
*In the first days of the event, about {{Green|9 million}} {{MobSprite|Shiny Pig;Shiny Pigs}} were killed every {{Green|24}} hours.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/HypixelSkyblock/comments/mtf551/second_relic_was_given_by_mini_also_the_chances/gv01pfe/</ref>
* During the {{Green|21}} days that the original event lasted, {{Green|53 million}} '''Shiny Orbs''' were used.<ref>https://twitter.com/Minikloon/status/1390767801007288324</ref>
